descriptionProgressScope: Compares completed work with total scope by items and points.
descriptionWip: Shows the current distribution of work in progress by status.
descriptionBlocked: Shows how many items are blocked and which have accumulated the most days.
descriptionOverdue: Compares overdue items and points with the remaining scope.
descriptionBurnup: Shows how scope and completed items changed over time.
descriptionAging: Lists the oldest WIP items since their current episode began.
descriptionTeamLoad: Shows the amount of work in progress for each assignee.
descriptionHours: Sums hours entered in manual logs, grouped by author.
